description: One coin in full: the overall call, each window running now (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d) blended across venues with score, up probability, confidence and the move since the window opened, the next windows, each venue's own reading, the daily regime call, the Cryptohopper markets that get its signals and its latest delivery, the live backtest, and the newest headlines that name it.
